metadata.title: Deep Learning Mid-Semester Internal Assessment
metadata.instructions: Answer all questions to the best of your ability. Choose either option A or B for each question.

questions.question_text: Explain the difference between machine learning and deep learning. (Option A) OR Describe the biological neuron vs artificial neuron. (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that involves training algorithms to make predictions or decisions based on data. Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that involves the use of neural networks with multiple layers to analyze data. Option B: Biological neurons are the basic units of the brain, responsible for transmitting and processing information. Artificial neurons are the basic units of a neural network, designed to mimic the behavior of biological neurons.

questions.question_text: What are the limitations of the Perceptron model? (Option A) OR Explain the Perceptron Convergence Theorem. (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: The Perceptron model is limited in its ability to learn complex patterns and relationships in data. Option B: The Perceptron Convergence Theorem states that the Perceptron model will converge to a solution if the data is linearly separable.

questions.question_text: Explain the working of deep forward networks. (Option A) OR Describe the architecture of a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: Deep forward networks are a type of neural network that consists of multiple layers of artificial neurons, where each layer processes the input data and passes the output to the next layer. Option B: The architecture of an MLP consists of an input layer, one or more hidden layers, and an output layer, where each layer is fully connected to the next layer.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of activation functions in a neural network? (Option A) OR Explain the difference between sequential and temporal data. (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: Activation functions are used to introduce non-linearity into the neural network, allowing it to learn complex patterns and relationships in data. Option B: Sequential data refers to data that has a sequential or temporal structure, such as time series data or text data. Temporal data refers to data that has a temporal structure, such as data that is measured at regular time intervals.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of supervised learning. (Option A) OR Describe the working of a support vector machine. (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: Supervised learning is a type of machine learning where the algorithm is trained on labeled data, and the goal is to learn a mapping between input data and output labels. Option B: A support vector machine is a type of supervised learning algorithm that uses a hyperplane to separate the data into different classes.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of autoencoders in deep learning? (Option A) OR Explain the concept of generative models. (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: Autoencoders are used to learn a compact representation of the input data, and can be used for dimensionality reduction or anomaly detection. Option B: Generative models are a type of deep learning model that is used to generate new data samples that are similar to the training data.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of transformers and attention mechanisms. (Option A) OR Describe the architecture of a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: Transformers are a type of neural network that uses self-attention mechanisms to process sequential data. Option B: A VAE is a type of generative model that consists of an encoder and a decoder, where the encoder maps the input data to a latent space, and the decoder maps the latent space back to the input data.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of self-attention mechanisms in transformers. (Option A) OR Describe the architecture of a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). (Option B)
questions.answer_key: Option A: Self-attention mechanisms are used in transformers to allow the model to attend to different parts of the input sequence simultaneously. Option B: A GAN consists of a generator and a discriminator, where the generator generates new data samples, and the discriminator evaluates the generated samples and tells the generator whether they are realistic or not.
